items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My grandmother was a spiritual woman in the sense that she chose Christian Science because it was founded by Mary Baker Eddy

ctx.x: Well my grandmother was a Christian Scientist. She went to Christian Sciences. My mother didn't go to church until later. She went to Baptist Church much later on in her life, toward the end of her life. But my grandmother went to Christian Science Church and so as a result, I went also. They had a Sunday school for me, and they had the major service for the adults, which went on simultaneously but in different parts of the church. My grandmother was a spiritual woman in the sense that she chose Christian Science…

So if we could also look at the historical records, perhaps correct a few things that continually show up in your various biographies. Could you perhaps clarify your experience at the Chicago Conservatory of Music?
